49.title: The Inhabited Worlds
49.b0.ask: “Mortals on countless worlds differ in how they breathe, how tall they stand, and how their brains are built — so what makes them one, and by what roads do they leave their native worlds?”
49.b2.p: In Papers 45 through 48 we followed the road that lies beyond death — Jerusem, the mansion worlds, and the morontia life. Now Paper 49 turns our gaze back to where that road begins. All mortal-inhabited worlds are evolutionary in origin and nature; they are the evolutionary cradle of the mortal races of time and space. Each stage of the ascending life is a training school for the stage just ahead (49:0.1).
49.b3.p: The inhabited worlds are grouped into local systems of about one thousand worlds each. Satania is an unfinished system with only 619 inhabited worlds. Urantia was the 606th world in our system on which human beings appeared, and so it bears the number 606 of Satania (49:0.2-0.3). Not every planet is suited to life. The oldest inhabited world of Satania, world number one, is Anova, one of forty-four satellites circling an enormous dark planet (49:0.4-0.5).
49.b4.p: How different, then, are the mortals of all these worlds? Beneath all their differences, what do they share? And by what ways do they leave their earthly life and enter the stream of ascension?
49.b5.q: ⟦Q 49:4.9⟧The mind of man is mortal; only the bestowed spirit is immortal.⟦/Q⟧
49.b8.p: The progress of life is neither arbitrary nor magical. Cosmic evolution may not always be predictable, but it is strictly nonaccidental (49:1.1). The Life Carriers are the living catalyzers who start the first reactions of material life, and no two worlds are exactly alike in their plant and animal life (49:1.2-1.3).
49.b9.p: On every world the plant form comes first and is quite fully developed before the animal patterns appear; all animal types grow out of the basic patterns of plant life (49:1.5). Mortal man is no accident of evolution. Mice reproduce much faster than elephants, yet elephants evolve faster than mice (49:1.6). That is why superior strains of living protoplasm, once they appear, should be carefully guarded (49:1.7).
49.b10.q: ⟦Q 49:1.6⟧Mortal man is not an evolutionary accident.⟦/Q⟧
49.b12.p: The Life Carriers adapt the standard pattern of the system to the different conditions they meet on each world. The result is seven distinct physical types, along with thousands of minor variations (49:2.1).
49.b13.t: Distribution in Satania and Urantia’s place
Over 91% are mid-breathers — Urantia is a mid-breather world
Water 7%, air 10%, land 70%, combined land-and-air 13% — Urantia is of the land order
20% are modified gravity types; heights range from about 2½ to about 10 feet
30% are modified temperature types — Urantia is number three of five
Ten designs — Urantia is number four (about 23%)
Six types of nutrition — Urantia uses the third
49.b14.t: A thin atmosphere like that of Mars — about 2.5%
An atmosphere like that of Venus — about 5%
49.b15.p: Yet none of these physical differences affects the intellectual or the spiritual life (49:2.22, 2.26).
49.b17.p: Mortals live even on planets with little or no air. Such worlds make up less than seven per cent of the inhabited worlds of Orvonton and less than three per cent of Nebadon; Satania has only nine (49:3.1). They are rare in Satania because our region still abounds in meteoric bodies, and worlds without a protective atmosphere are under constant bombardment (49:3.2-3.3).
49.b18.p: The nonbreathers neither eat food nor drink water. Their metabolism and almost every act of living differ from ours, and even in survival they differ, being candidates for Spirit fusion. Yet in mind and character they are no different from other mortals, and they enjoy life with the same trials and joys (49:3.4-3.5). Such a race lives on a sphere close to Urantia (49:3.6).
49.b20.p: All mortals of will dignity are erect animals, walking on two feet (49:4.1). There are six basic evolutionary races, and many of the three-brained planets have only the three primary races (49:4.2).
49.b22.p: Sex equality prevails on all advanced worlds, and no planet is regarded as having emerged from barbarism so long as one sex seeks to tyrannize over the other (49:4.4). The length of life ranges from twenty-five years on primitive worlds to nearly five hundred on older, advanced spheres (49:4.6). Because mind is the bestowal of the Infinite Spirit, the mental life of all mortals, and their careers just after death, are very much alike, whatever the structure of their bodies (49:4.8).
49.b23.p: But mortal mind without immortal spirit cannot survive. Survival depends on spiritualization through the ministry of the Adjuster — on the birth and growth of the immortal soul (49:4.9).
49.b25.p: Mortal creatures can be studied from seven points of view, and each mortal belongs to some category in every one of them at the same time (49:5.1-5.9).
49.b26.t: Normal, radical, and experimental — Urantia is an experimental planet
One-, two-, and three-brained — Urantians are two-brained
One, two, or three special glands — Urantia is of the second group (65%)
The dispensations brought by the successive divine Sons
Horizontal groupings by type and series
Almost 90% of the inhabited worlds of Nebadon are Adjuster-fusion worlds
Only one way to be born, but many ways to leave
49.b27.p: Two-brained Urantians are more imaginative and philosophical than the one-brained, but somewhat less spiritual and worshipful than the three-brained (49:5.13). Even so, the three orders stand on an equal footing in the ascension career and must pass the same tests (49:5.18). And differences in spirit receptivity do not survive natural death (49:5.20).
49.b28.t: The magisterial mission of an Avonal Son
The Sovereign Son, Michael, came himself
The vestibule to the age of light and life
49.b30.p: All types of mortals alike receive the ministry of Thought Adjusters and guardian angels, and all alike go on to the morontia worlds (49:6.1). Besides the resurrections that open each new dispensation, special resurrections are held at least every millennium, when “⟦Q 49:6.2⟧many of those who sleep in the dust awake⟦/Q⟧” (49:6.2). The ways of leaving fall into five orders (49:6.4-6.21).
49.b31.t: They sleep and are repersonalized at the dispensational roll call
Having reached the third circle, they awaken on the first mansion world on the third day
Young children — they follow their parents to the system finaliter world
They pass through death but skip the mansion worlds and more
Translated without death — those who fuse with their Adjusters
49.b32.p: The soul of a sleeping survivor is held in trust by the guardian seraphim, while the Adjuster serves on Divinington and never indwells another mind in the meantime. When the two come together again, identity is restored (49:6.4-6.5). Those who reach the third circle are assigned personal guardians of destiny (49:6.8). Those who skip the mansion worlds must later go back to them as teachers (49:6.17). And on worlds long settled in light and life, natural death becomes less and less frequent (49:6.21).
49.b34.p: Paper 49 shows us a universe with countless inhabited worlds, whose mortals differ in how they breathe, how tall they are, and how their brains are built. Urantia is an average world of mid-breathers, yet it is also an experimental planet with an exceptional history of rebellion, default, and Michael’s bestowal. But all these differences belong only to the body and the earthly life. Every mind is the gift of the Infinite Spirit; every survival depends on the soul that grows with the Adjuster; and though the ways of leaving are many, all join the same stream of ascension. In many kinds of bodies dwells one and the same spiritual destiny.
49.b35.t: The evolution of life is no accident but an orderly plan
Physical differences do not affect the intellectual or spiritual life
Even those who do not breathe are like us in mind and character
The mind is mortal; only the bestowed spirit is immortal
Urantia is an experimental planet of two-brained mid-breathers
There is one way to be born, but many ways to leave
49.b37.box: However much their bodies and worlds may differ, all mortals are one in the same gift of spirit and the same destiny of ascension.
50.title: The Planetary Princes
50.b0.ask: “If an unseen Son leads a primitive world all the way to light and life, what is left for a world like ours that lost its Prince?”
50.b2.p: In Paper 49 we saw how the mortals of countless inhabited worlds differ and how they are one. Now Paper 50 turns to the being who first takes charge of those worlds: the Planetary Prince. The Planetary Princes belong to the order of Lanonandek Sons, but they are so specialized in service that they are commonly regarded as a distinct group (50:0.1).
50.b3.p: After their Melchizedek certification as secondary Lanonandeks, they are assigned to the reserves of their order on the constellation headquarters. The System Sovereign gives them various duties, and in time commissions them as Planetary Princes. When the Life Carriers have developed intelligent evolutionary beings on a planet and ask for an administrative head, the System Sovereign assigns a ruler to that world. Every planet inhabited by evolutionary mortals receives a ruler of this order (50:0.1-0.2).
50.b4.p: What, then, does a Planetary Prince do, and how does he lead a world from its primitive state to light and life? And what remains for a world like Urantia, whose Prince joined a rebellion?
50.b5.q: ⟦Q 50:6.4⟧Culture presupposes quality of mind; culture cannot be enhanced unless mind is elevated.⟦/Q⟧
50.b8.p: Aside from incarnation, the Planetary Prince is the nearest personal approach that the Eternal Son of Paradise can make to the lowly creatures of time and space. Of all the orders of personal Sons reaching out from Paradise to the children of men, the Prince is the last. On a newly inhabited world he is the sole representative of complete divinity (50:1.1).
50.b9.t: How each comes near to man
Touches the creatures of the realms through his spirit
Comes near in the persons of the guardians of destiny and other angelic beings
Lives in man by the prepersonal presence of the Mystery Monitors
The Eternal Son and his Sons
The Planetary Prince — their last effort to draw near
50.b10.p: But personalities so close to man also carry greater risks. The leaders of new worlds come from the lower orders of system administrators so that they will truly sympathize with planetary problems — and this raises the danger that they may exalt their own minds above the will of the Supreme Rulers (50:1.2). Being quite alone as representatives of divinity on their planets, they are tested severely, and the fact that the Father is not personally present in the local universe is itself a test of faith and loyalty. Nebadon has suffered several rebellions (50:1.3). Still, the Princes do not often fail, and their success greatly helps the later missions of the Material Sons and the Paradise Sons (50:1.4).
50.b12.p: All Planetary Princes are under the administrative jurisdiction of Gabriel, Michael’s chief executive, and in immediate authority they answer to the System Sovereigns (50:2.1). A Prince may seek the counsel of the Melchizedeks, his former teachers, but unless he asks, the Melchizedeks do not interfere. He may also draw on the advice of the four and twenty counselors of the system; in Satania these counselors are at present all natives of Urantia (50:2.2).
50.b13.p: In its early, unsettled career the rule of an evolutionary planet is largely autocratic. The Prince usually has a supreme council of twelve, and his staff averages about one thousand, though as the planet progresses it may grow to one hundred thousand or more (50:2.3-2.4). Every planet has tribunals of justice; the judicial system of the local universe begins in the tribunals of the Prince, and their decrees are highly fatherly and discretionary (50:2.5).
50.b14.t: Gabriel (administration) and the System Sovereign (immediate command)
The Melchizedeks and the four and twenty counselors — only on request
Usually twelve, chosen differently on each world
About one thousand on average; may grow to one hundred thousand or more
Presided over by a member of the Prince’s staff; appeal to higher courts is possible
50.b15.p: Roving commissions of conciliators supplement the planetary courts, but no arbitrary execution is ever carried out without the consent of the Constellation Father, for the “⟦Q 50:2.6|3:5.2|97:8.5⟧Most Highs rule in the kingdoms of men⟦/Q⟧” (50:2.6). The main reason for bringing ascending mortals onto the Prince’s staff is to make communication with the people of the planet easier (50:2.7).
50.b17.p: When a Prince goes to a young world, he takes with him volunteer ascenders from the system headquarters. These material helpers are the connecting link between the Prince and the world races; Caligastia, the Prince of Urantia, had one hundred of them (50:3.1). They are citizens of the system capital who have not yet fused with their Adjusters, and while they are on the planet, their Adjusters remain at the system headquarters. The Life Carriers give them new physical bodies, which are free from the ordinary diseases but still subject to mechanical accidents (50:3.2-3.3).
50.b18.p: These helpers seldom mate with the world races, but they always mate among themselves, and two classes of beings result from these unions (50:3.5). At the end of the Prince’s dispensation this “reversion staff” yields up their material bodies, passes through the transition slumber, awakens in morontia form, and returns to the system capital. They are a whole dispensation behind their Jerusem class, but they have gained a unique and extraordinary experience, a rare chapter in the career of an ascending mortal (50:3.6).
50.b19.t: Born of unions among the staff members
Certain high types of material beings
Remain attached to the Prince’s staff even after Adam and Eve arrive
If they mate with mortals in an emergency, they rank with the superior races of their day
50.b21.p: The corporeal staff soon set up schools of training and culture at the planetary headquarters, where the best of the evolutionary races are taught and then sent back to teach their own people (50:4.1). In the headquarters settlement on Urantia, students and teachers alike were farmers and gardeners, and their time was divided about equally among five pursuits (50:4.3).
50.b22.t: Cultivating the soil, together with building and adorning homes
Individual instruction with family-group teaching, plus specialized classes
Schools of marriage and homemaking, art and craft, and the training of teachers
The teacher brotherhood, the enlightenment of youth, and training native missionaries
50.b23.p: The Prince himself is not visible to mortals, so believing the word of his semimaterial staff was a test of faith (50:4.9). Even so, a civilizing influence spread out from these schools, and the trained children returned home to found new centers of learning (50:4.10). But on Urantia the whole enterprise came to a sudden and most inglorious end when Caligastia joined the Lucifer rebellion. With deliberate malice he perverted the teaching of all the planetary schools, and their wreck was speedy and complete (50:4.11-4.12).
50.b24.p: Yet many of the descendants of the staff stayed loyal and left Caligastia. Encouraged by the Melchizedek receivers, these loyalists and their descendants helped prevent the total loss of spiritual truth on Urantia and kept alive some knowledge of the Father’s rule (50:4.13).
50.b26.p: A loyal Prince stays permanently attached to the planet of his first assignment. Paradise Sons and their dispensations may come and go, but a successful Prince continues as the ruler of his realm, fostering the growth of civilization (50:5.1). Civilization hardly ever progresses the same way on two planets, yet all evolutionary worlds move in certain clear directions, and the races of an average world pass through seven developmental epochs (50:5.2-5.3).
50.b27.t: Life is taken up with finding food and fighting
The technique of war, fortified homes, and clans held together
Luxury vies with necessity; the weaker drift into excess
4. The quest for knowledge and wisdom
Civilization learns from experience — education is the watchword
5. The epoch of philosophy and brotherhood
An ethical society living by the golden rule
Religion rises from fear to cosmic wisdom
7. The era of light and life
All achievements blended in cosmic unity and unselfish service
50.b28.p: The effort to put knowledge into practice results in wisdom, and when a culture has learned to profit and improve by experience, civilization has really arrived (50:5.7). Princes who have served their worlds through many dispensations are elevated to Planetary Sovereigns when the era of light and life begins (50:5.11).
50.b30.p: Because of Urantia’s isolation, little can be told about our neighbors in Satania (50:6.1). Compared with the loyal worlds, our planet seems the most confused and the most retarded in every phase of intellectual progress and spiritual attainment (50:6.2). Yet even the most ideal evolutionary world is no flowery bed of ease. The early life of the mortal races is always attended by struggle, and effort and decision are an essential part of gaining survival values (50:6.3).
50.b31.q: ⟦Q 50:6.4⟧Superior intellect will seek a noble culture and find some way to attain such a goal. Inferior minds will spurn the highest culture even when presented to them ready-made.⟦/Q⟧
50.b32.p: For two hundred thousand years all the worlds of Satania have rested under a spiritual ban because of the Lucifer rebellion, and it will take age upon age to make up for the results. Our world still follows an irregular and checkered course because of the double tragedy of a rebellious Planetary Prince and a defaulting Material Son, and even the bestowal of Christ Michael did not at once set aside the temporal consequences (50:6.5).
50.b34.p: At first glance, isolated worlds like Urantia seem the most unfortunate of all, deprived of the presence of a Planetary Prince and a Material Son and Daughter. But isolation gives their races a unique opportunity to exercise faith — to develop a confidence in cosmic reliability that does not depend on sight. In the end, mortals from such worlds may prove extremely fortunate, and they are very early entrusted with special assignments where unquestioned faith is essential (50:7.1).
50.b35.q: ⟦Q 50:7.2⟧Agondonters, meaning evolutionary will creatures who can believe without seeing, persevere when isolated, and triumph over insuperable difficulties even when alone.⟦/Q⟧
50.b36.p: On Jerusem they occupy a residential sector of their own. Their grouping persists through the local universe and the superuniverse, disappears during the stay in Havona, reappears on Paradise, and continues in the Corps of the Mortal Finality (50:7.2). All through the Paradise career, reward follows effort as the result of causes; this gives each creature a distinct experience and adds to the versatility of the finaliters (50:7.3).
50.b38.p: Paper 50 is the story of the Son who first takes charge of a planet — and the story of our world, which lost that Son. A loyal Prince founds schools and leads his world through seven epochs to light and life, but on Urantia that road was cut off by Caligastia’s betrayal. Yet the paper does not end in sorrow. Loyal descendants kept the spark of truth alive, and isolation itself became a place to grow a faith that believes without seeing. Those who held on by faith, without the visible help of a Prince, are called agondonters and carry that name all the way to Paradise. Our world’s misfortune may turn out to be our own special opportunity.
50.b39.t: The Prince is the Eternal Son’s last personal effort to draw near to man
The justice of the local universe begins in the Prince’s tribunals
Volunteer ascenders link the Prince with the races
The schools spread civilization but fell through Caligastia’s betrayal
Every world moves through seven epochs toward light and life
Culture presupposes quality of mind, and no world is without struggle
The faith of agondonters, who believe without seeing, is the reward of isolation
50.b41.box: Even on a world that lost its visible Prince, faith that believes without seeing becomes a reward that reaches all the way to Paradise.
51.title: The Planetary Adams
51.b0.ask: “What were the Adam and Eve who came from on high meant to give an evolutionary world — and since that plan miscarried here, what did we lose, and what did we receive?”
51.b2.p: In Paper 50 we watched the Planetary Prince take charge of a primitive world, found schools, and nurture civilization. When primitive man reaches the limit of natural evolutionary development during the Prince’s dispensation, the System Sovereign sends the second order of sonship, the biologic uplifters. This Material Son and Daughter are usually known on their planet as Adam and Eve (51:0.1).
51.b3.p: They are the material gift of the Creator Son to the inhabited worlds, and together with the Planetary Prince they remain on their planet throughout its evolution. On a world with a loyal Prince the venture carries little hazard, but on an apostate planet without a spiritual ruler it is fraught with grave danger (51:0.2). On Urantia the plan for improving the races miscarried, yet Adam’s mission was not in vain; our world has profited immeasurably from the gift of Adam and Eve (51:0.3).
51.b4.p: What kind of beings, then, are the Material Son and Daughter, and what plan do they carry out on a normal world? And what did our world lose when that plan went wrong?
51.b5.q: ⟦Q 51:6.5⟧In these immortal Material Sons and Daughters we encounter the last and the indispensable link connecting God with man⟦/Q⟧
51.b7.h: 1. Origin and Nature of the Material Sons of God
51.b8.p: The Material Sons and Daughters are the offspring of the Creator Son; the Universe Mother Spirit does not take part in producing them. The Creator Son makes only one pair in each local system, and each pair is attuned to the life pattern of its system. The Adam and Eve who came to Urantia were descended from the original Satania pair (51:1.1-1.2).
51.b9.t: Eight to ten feet tall, glowing with radiant light of a violet hue
Equal but differential, hence complemental — they serve almost always in pairs
Dual: they take in materialized energy and also sustaining cosmic energies
None — through their service they gain the capacity for Adjuster indwelling
Visible to material creatures, and able to mingle with them
51.b10.p: If they fail in their mission or deliberately rebel, they are cut off from the universe source of light and life, become practically material beings, and eventually meet material death (51:1.4). The original Adam and Eve are immortal, but they cannot pass unconditioned immortality on to their children, whose continuing life depends on unbroken harmony with the mind-gravity circuit of the Spirit. In Satania thirteen Planetary Adams have been lost in rebellion and default (51:1.5). These beings are the connecting links between the spiritual and physical worlds, and the children they bear on an evolutionary planet live a little less long with each generation (51:1.6, 1.8).
51.b12.p: When an inhabited world reaches the height of physical evolution, the System Sovereign convenes the corps of Material Sons and Daughters, and from among the volunteers an Adam and an Eve of the senior corps are chosen (51:2.1). Being semimaterial, they cannot be carried by seraphim as they are; first they must be dematerialized (51:2.2).
51.b13.t: An Adam and Eve chosen from the volunteers on the system capital
About three days of standard time on the system capital
They cross space in the deep sleep of the seraphim
Ten to twenty-eight days, under the direction of the Life Carriers
51.b14.p: There is a technique for dematerializing the Adams to send them from Jerusem to an evolutionary world, but no matching way to bring them back. Only if a physical catastrophe forces a whole planet to be emptied is this technique installed in an emergency for all survivors, who are then carried to a new world (51:2.3). When the reassembly is complete, the Material Son and Daughter stand on their new world just as they were on Jerusem (51:2.4).
51.b16.p: The Material Son and Daughter build their garden home on a site chosen by the Prince. These Gardens of Eden are named in honor of Edentia, the constellation capital, and they are usually set in a secluded spot in a near-tropic zone (51:3.1-3.2). Their chief business is to multiply and to uplift the children of time, but they do not mix with the native peoples at once; for many generations they build up a strong race of their own. This is the origin of the violet race (51:3.3).
51.b17.p: On Urantia, Caligastia offered crafty opposition. Although the Melchizedek receivers had warned them, he outmaneuvered the Edenic pair by a wily stratagem and trapped them into violating the covenant of their trusteeship. Yet he failed to draw them into the Lucifer rebellion (51:3.4). The voice in the Garden that rebuked them was not the Lord God but the seraphim Solonia, chief of the planetary helpers. Because our traditions tend to ascribe everything supernatural to God, the nature of the Universal Father has often been confused (51:3.5).
51.b18.t: Machiventa Melchizedek, in the days of Abraham
51.b19.p: The Adamic mission brings with it the secondary midway creatures, who are distinct from the primary midwayers of the Prince’s age. Since Pentecost the loyal primary and secondary midwayers have voluntarily united and worked as one unit (51:3.6-3.8). The paper laments how much more beautiful it would have been had Michael been welcomed by a loyal Prince and a successful Material Son — but not all worlds have been as unfortunate as Urantia (51:3.9).
51.b21.p: The first race to reach human levels in the early ages of an inhabited world is the red man, and the other colored peoples appear soon after. The Life Carriers give the full bestowal of living energies to the first race, and each later race shows variation at the expense of that original endowment (51:4.1-4.2).
51.b22.t: The violet race — the descendants of Adam and Eve
51.b23.p: The division into several races gives mortal types a desirable variety, and this benefits mankind as a whole once the races are upstepped by the violet race. On Urantia, however, this plan of amalgamation was not extensively carried out (51:4.4). On early planets the more backward peoples are used as laborers, and so slavery arises; but on all normal worlds this primitive slavery is abolished soon after the violet race arrives (51:4.6-4.7). Before the races are blended, the Planetary Prince and the Material Son, with other authorities, pass upon the fitness of the reproducing strains (51:4.8).
51.b24.h: 5. Racial Amalgamation—Bestowal of the Adamic Blood
51.b25.p: The violet people usually do not begin to blend with the natives until their own number passes one million. On normal worlds Adam and Eve themselves never mate with the evolutionary races; that work belongs to their descendants. The Prince’s staff bring superior men and women to the Garden for voluntary mating with the Adamic offspring, and to be chosen as such a candidate is considered the highest honor (51:5.2-5.3).
51.b26.p: For the first time racial wars and tribal struggles diminish, as the races strive to qualify for admission to the Garden (51:5.4). The violet race is monogamous, and the children of these unions are trained in the Prince’s schools and then return to the race of their evolutionary parent (51:5.5). When the Adamic strain is added, more progress is made in one hundred thousand years than in a million years of former struggle (51:5.6). Since Urantia failed to carry out this plan, it must now work out race improvement by largely human methods (51:5.7).
51.b28.p: On most worlds the Garden of Eden long remains the second center of world culture and, together with the Prince’s headquarters city, sets the pace of civilization. The two schools work side by side in harmony, and in the end they merge into one (51:6.1-6.2, 6.4).
51.b29.t: The schools of the Planetary Prince
Philosophy, religion, morals, and the higher intellectual and artistic achievements
The garden schools of Adam and Eve
Practical arts, basic intellectual training, social culture, economics, trade, and civil government
51.b30.p: The Material Son and Daughter can see the invisible Planetary Prince and his staff, and so can interpret him to mortals. They are thus the last link bridging the gulf between the eternal Creator and the lowest finite personalities (51:6.5). As the centuries pass and their descendants blend with the races, they come to be accepted as the common parents of mankind, and mortals who start out from an inhabited world are meant to recognize seven fathers (51:6.6).
51.b31.t: The Creator Son, supreme ruler of the local creation
The Ancients of Days who govern the superuniverse
The Universal Father, who dwells on Paradise
51.b33.p: The first Avonal Son to arrive on a magisterial mission opens the fourth dispensation. Where he is universally accepted, he stays for an age, and the world prospers under the joint rule of three Sons — the Planetary Prince, the Material Son, and the Magisterial Son — the last two visible to everyone (51:7.1). When the Magisterial Son departs, Adam takes over the outward direction of the world, and when the Prince becomes Planetary Sovereign in the era of light and life, Adam and Eve become what might be called joint prime ministers (51:7.2).
51.b34.t: The Planetary Prince and his staff
The physical, scientific, and economic status of the realm
The arts, social relations, and intellectual achievements
51.b35.q: ⟦Q 51:7.5⟧If Urantians could only observe life on such a planet, they would immediately appreciate the value of those things which their world has lost through embracing evil and participating in rebellion.⟦/Q⟧
51.b37.p: Paper 51 shows Adam and Eve not as figures remembered for one mistake but as part of the universe’s settled plan for evolutionary worlds. On a normal world they found a garden, raise up the violet race, uplift the peoples through voluntary unions, form with the Prince the two centers of civilization, and in the era of light and life become joint prime ministers. On Urantia that plan miscarried through Caligastia’s interference and the default of the Edenic pair, and we lost a great deal. Yet just as great progress followed the gift of Adam’s life plasm to our peoples, their mission was never in vain.

The Material Son and Daughter link spirit and matter and serve in pairs
They reach a new world by dematerialization, seraphic transport, and rematerialization
They found a garden and raise the violet race — a plan that miscarried on Urantia
The variety of the races was meant to be upstepped by the Adamic strain
5. Racial Amalgamation—Bestowal of the Adamic Blood
Voluntary unions bring more progress in 100,000 years than in a million
Eden is the second center of culture, and mortals come to know seven fathers
Three Sons rule together and lead the world to light and life
51.b40.box: Adam and Eve are the last link between God and man, and even on a world where their plan miscarried, their gift was not in vain.
52.title: Planetary Mortal Epochs
52.b0.ask: “From the primitive cave to the era of light and life, what ages does a world pass through — and where does our world, which fell out of step, now stand?”
52.b2.p: In Papers 50 and 51 we saw what the Planetary Prince and Adam and Eve were meant to give an evolutionary world. Now Paper 52 weaves all the visits of the divine Sons into one long story and sketches the whole human history of a planet. From the beginning of life to the era of light and life, at least seven mortal epochs appear on an evolutionary world, and these ages are set by the planetary missions of the divine Sons (52:0.1).
52.b3.p: The seven are: Pre-Planetary Prince Man, Post-Planetary Prince Man, Post-Adamic Man, Post-Magisterial Son Man, Post-Bestowal Son Man, Post-Teacher Son Man, and the Era of Light and Life (52:0.2-0.8). The whole period from the start of life to the appearance of man is the prehuman era, which comes before them all (52:0.9).
52.b4.p: What does each age look like on a normal world? And where does Urantia stand in that procession, having lost some of its Sons and received others out of order?
52.b5.q: ⟦Q 52:6.7⟧The brotherhood of man is, after all, predicated on the recognition of the fatherhood of God.⟦/Q⟧
52.b8.t: Tribal struggle, the religion of fear
The Spirit of Truth, world-wide peace
From time to the vestibule of eternity
52.b9.p: From the time man emerges from the animal level — when he can choose to worship the Creator — until the Planetary Prince arrives, mortals are called primitive men. The six colored races appear in the order of the spectrum, beginning with the red, and this period lasts anywhere from one hundred and fifty thousand to over one million years (52:1.1-1.2). The law of this age is the physical survival of the fittest, and government is wholly tribal (52:1.3). It is a long, dark, and bloody chapter, yet the achievements of primitive man are also a splendid, even heroic, chapter in the story of an evolutionary world (52:1.4).
52.b10.p: Primitive mortals live in caves or on cliffs, but they learn to handle fire and improve their tools, and soon they master the great animals. They even made use of enormous, intelligent birds able to carry a man over five hundred miles without stopping — and our own early ancestors enjoyed their services (52:1.5). Moral will usually appears along with early language, and all Adjuster-indwelt mortals are potential worshipers. The early religion of fear tames fiery tempers and becomes the soil in which the seeds of revealed religion are later planted (52:1.6-1.7).
52.b12.p: With the Prince’s arrival, government appears on earth, and a dispensation begins that averages around five hundred thousand years. Thought Adjusters come in growing numbers, and the seraphic guardians widen their supervision (52:2.1-2.2). Before the Prince, religion is wholly a product of evolution; from now on it advances both by evolutionary growth and by graduated revelation (52:2.3). But the Planetary Prince is not “⟦Q 52:2.5|52:6.1|68:3.5⟧the Prince of Peace.⟦/Q⟧” Racial struggles and tribal wars continue, though less often, and nationalism reaches its height (52:2.5).
52.b13.t: The great social achievement — the home begins to take shape
Normal worlds establish full equality of the sexes
Settled homes, domesticated animals, and the growth of home arts
Limiting the multiplication of defective individuals
52.b14.p: The paper says that it is futile sympathy to perpetuate hopelessly defective strains — yet it adds that there is abundant opportunity for tolerance and altruism toward the unfortunate who have not lost their moral heritage (52:2.11-2.12).
52.b16.p: When man reaches the peak of animal development, the Material Son and Daughter arrive; this is true on all evolutionary worlds (52:3.1). Adam himself has no Adjuster, but his descendants on the planet become candidates for receiving one. The prime purpose of this age is to move man from the hunter and herder stage to that of the farmer and gardener (52:3.2-3.3). The Adamic strain lifts intellectual capacity at once and speeds spiritual progress, making this the golden age of invention, mechanical development, and exploration. Urantia is a full dispensation and more behind the average schedule (52:3.6).
52.b17.p: By the end of this age the races are practically blended, and an olive shade of the violet hue becomes the racial “white” of the spheres (52:3.7). It is the age of internationalism: nationalism wanes, representative government takes hold, and the languages of the races give way to the tongue of the violet people (52:3.10). World-wide peace — the end of race conflict and national hostility — shows that a planet is ripe for the Magisterial Son (52:3.12).
52.b19.p: On a normal world this age begins with no race problems at all. All nations and races are of one blood, and the brotherhood of man flourishes (52:4.1). The Planetary Prince and the Material Sons come from the local universe, but the Magisterial Son comes from Paradise. When he comes only as a judge he is never incarnated, but on a magisterial mission — at least the first — he is always incarnated, though he does not experience birth or die the death of the realm (52:4.2-4.3).
52.b20.t: The daily work needed for independence is two and a half hours
Self-government — the highest type of representative government
Most mortals are indwelt, though the gift is not yet universal
A flowering of art, music, and higher learning, and a return to simpler living
52.b21.p: A world-wide spiritual awakening at the end of this age is the signal for the bestowal Son (52:4.8). If one mission does not make the planet ready, a second or third Magisterial Son comes, and each arrival ends one dispensation and opens another. These ages last from twenty-five thousand to fifty thousand years (52:4.9-4.10).
52.b23.p: When a world is ripe for spiritualization, the bestowal Son arrives. He is usually of the Avonal order, except on the one world in each local universe where the Creator Son makes his final bestowal. Of nearly ten million worlds, Urantia was that world — and Michael appeared at an unusual time, at the close of the Adamic dispensation (52:5.1-5.2). The bestowal Son lives and dies for the spiritual uplift of mortals and establishes the “⟦Q 52:5.4|52:5.5|101:6.17⟧new and living way⟦/Q⟧” (52:5.4).
52.b24.p: On Urantia this new way was a matter of fact as well. Because of the Lucifer rebellion, the process by which mortals pass directly to the mansion worlds at death had been suspended, but since Pentecost they may again go straight to the morontia spheres (52:5.5). After the bestowal Son rises on the third day and ascends, the Spirit of Truth is poured out, and from then on every normal-minded will creature receives an Adjuster as soon as it reaches the age of moral choice (52:5.6).
52.b25.q: ⟦Q 52:5.4⟧His life is an incarnation of Paradise truth in mortal flesh, that very truth—even the Spirit of Truth—in the knowledge of which men shall be free.⟦/Q⟧
52.b26.p: This age lasts from ten thousand to a hundred thousand years, and it becomes possible to put the golden rule into practice. Disease and delinquency are virtually solved, and the average life span climbs above three hundred years. There are many nations, but only one race, one language, and one religion (52:5.8-5.10).
52.b28.p: On a normal world the bestowal Son is the Prince of Peace, and his age is one of world-wide peace. But Urantia is out of step in the planetary procession. The Master warned that his coming would not bring the usual reign of peace and that there would be “⟦Q 52:6.1|134:6.3|176:1.1⟧wars and rumors of wars⟦/Q⟧” (52:6.1). On a spiritually isolated world, unaided social evolution can hardly bring about brotherhood; religious revelation is essential (52:6.2).
52.b29.t: Travel, commerce, and play; a common language; exchange of students and teachers
Knowing one another’s literature and thought — ignorance breeds suspicion
Seeing the sinfulness of intolerance and fratricidal strife
International justice instead of war; politics for the welfare of humanity
Brotherhood that rests on recognizing the fatherhood of God
52.b30.p: The quickest way to brotherhood is the spiritual transformation of present-day humanity. Social evolution speeds up when spiritual pressure is applied from above, moral insight grows, and the soul’s capacity to understand and love every other mortal increases (52:6.7). If we were moved to a normal planet in its post-bestowal age, we would think we had been taken to the heaven of our traditions (52:6.8).
52.b32.p: The next Sons to arrive are the Trinity Teacher Sons. Here too Urantia is out of step, because Jesus has promised to return. That promise he will certainly fulfill, but no one knows whether his second coming will come before or after the Magisterial or Teacher Sons (52:7.1). A planetary Teacher Son comes with seventy primary Sons, twelve secondary Sons, and three of the most experienced Daynals, and they stay not less than a thousand years (52:7.2).
52.b33.p: In this age Adjusters increasingly fuse with their subjects during life in the flesh, many mortals are translated from among the living, and natural death becomes less frequent (52:7.4). Life spans approach five hundred years, representative government gives way to the rule of individual self-control, and running the world takes about one hour a day from each adult (52:7.5-7.6). Even so, the people of such a world are still finite; nothing is perfect (52:7.9).
52.b34.q: ⟦Q 52:7.14⟧Sooner or later the grace of God and the ministry of angels will usher in the day of the advent of the Trinity Teacher Sons; and their departure, following their final mission, will inaugurate this superb era of light and life.⟦/Q⟧
52.b35.p: At the close of one of the Teacher Sons’ missions, the Planetary Prince becomes Planetary Sovereign, and the System Sovereign proclaims the era of light and life (52:7.10). Whatever a world’s past — wholly loyal or cursed by sin — that day comes. It is the dawn of the threshold of the transition from time to the vestibule of eternity (52:7.14, 7.16).
52.b37.p: Paper 52 shows that the history of a world is not a string of accidents but an orderly growth marked off by the visits of the divine Sons. The road runs from the fear religion of primitive man through family and farming, race blending, economic liberation, the Spirit of Truth, and mortals translated while still alive, all the way to light and life — the universal procession of normal worlds. Urantia has fallen out of that procession through rebellion and default, and even after the bestowal Son came, peace did not follow. Yet this paper points the way. The brotherhood of man begins with recognizing the fatherhood of God, and the spiritual transformation of each person today is the fastest way to open that road. And to every world, whatever its past, the day of light and life will come at last.
52.b38.t: The religion of fear is crude, yet it is soil for revealed religion
Family life and farming grow, and revelation is added to religion
Invention, race blending, and internationalism lead to world peace
Economic liberation and self-government prepare a spiritual awakening
The Spirit of Truth is poured out and the golden rule becomes practical
Brotherhood begins with recognizing the fatherhood of God
Mortals are translated, and the world reaches the threshold of light and life
52.b40.box: To every world, whatever its past, the day of light and life will come — and the road to it is opened by a brotherhood of man that recognizes the fatherhood of God.
53.title: The Lucifer Rebellion
53.b0.ask: “Why did the most brilliant of Sons bring about his own downfall, and why did God not stop the rebellion at once?”
53.b2.p: In Papers 50 through 52 we saw the order in which the Sons come to a normal world and lead it to light and life — and each time we found that Urantia had fallen out of that procession. Now Paper 53 faces the root of that departure: the Lucifer rebellion. Lucifer was a brilliant primary Lanonandek Son of Nebadon, distinguished for wisdom, sagacity, and efficiency. He had been named one of the one hundred most able and brilliant personalities in more than seven hundred thousand of his kind (53:0.1).
53.b3.p: Yet through evil and error he embraced sin, and he became one of three System Sovereigns in Nebadon who surrendered to the sophistry of spurious personal liberty. In all of Nebadon, with its ten thousand systems, only three System Sovereigns have ever held the government of the Creator Son in contempt (53:0.1-0.2).
53.b4.p: Why, then, did so gifted a being rebel, and what did he claim? And why did Michael not stop him at once, but leave him free for so many ages?
53.b5.q: ⟦Q 53:8.8⟧Faith is an effective armor against sin and iniquity.⟦/Q⟧
53.b8.p: Lucifer was not an ascending being but a created Son of the local universe. As chief executive of a system of 607 inhabited worlds, he reigned “⟦Q 53:1.1⟧upon the holy mountain of God,⟦/Q⟧” the administrative mount of Jerusem (53:1.1). He was a magnificent personality who stood next to the Most High Fathers of the constellations in the line of universe authority. But self-contemplation is most disastrous, even to the exalted personalities of heaven: his beauty lifted up his heart, and his brightness corrupted his wisdom (53:1.2-1.3).
53.b9.t: The deposed System Sovereign of Satania
Lucifer’s first lieutenant, who pleaded his cause on Urantia
The “devil” — the deposed Planetary Prince of Urantia
Caligastia’s chief of staff, chief executive of the Urantia rebels
Leader of the disloyal midway creatures
A name that came to symbolize all these evil personages
53.b10.p: While Michael was on Urantia in the flesh, Lucifer, Satan, and Caligastia joined forces to defeat his bestowal mission, but they signally failed (53:1.4).
53.b12.p: Lucifer and Satan had reigned on Jerusem for more than five hundred thousand years when in their hearts they began to set themselves against the Universal Father and Michael (53:2.1). There were no special conditions in Satania that favored rebellion, and no one ever suggested it to Lucifer. The idea arose in his own mind, and his relations with the Creator Son had always been intimate and cordial (53:2.2-2.3). Outwardly he said nothing, but for more than a hundred years the Union of Days on Salvington had been reporting that all was not at peace in Lucifer’s mind (53:2.3).
53.b13.p: The exact cause is hard to name, but one thing is certain: a pride of self that fed itself until it became self-deception. For a time Lucifer truly believed his plans were for the good of the system, but by the time he reached disillusionment he had gone too far for his pride to let him stop. At some point he became insincere, and evil turned into deliberate and willful sin. He was long offered the chance to repent, but he rejected Michael’s mercy with ever-growing contempt (53:2.5).
53.b15.p: Whatever began the trouble in their hearts, the final outbreak took shape as the Lucifer Declaration of Liberty. The rebels stated their cause under three heads (53:3.1).
53.b16.t: 1. The reality of the Universal Father
The Father is a myth invented by the Paradise Sons, and personality is not his gift
Local systems should be autonomous; the Ancients of Days are tyrants and usurpers
3. The plan of ascendant mortal training
Too much discipline for a fictitious destiny — ascenders should have self-determination
53.b17.p: He claimed that immortality was inherent in system personalities and that resurrection was automatic, and he hinted that the finaliters had deceived all creation because they never brought back a clear idea of the Father’s personality. He traded on reverence as ignorance — and this very attack made the ascending citizens of Jerusem stand firm in resistance (53:3.2, 3.5-3.6).
53.b19.p: The manifesto was issued about two hundred thousand years ago, on the last day of the year, at the annual conclave of Satania on the sea of glass. Satan proclaimed that worship might be given to the universal forces, but allegiance only to Lucifer, the “⟦Q 53:4.1⟧God of liberty⟦/Q⟧” (53:4.1). Self-assertion was the battle cry. Lucifer championed the “⟦Q 53:4.2⟧equality of mind⟦/Q⟧” and “⟦Q 53:4.2⟧the brotherhood of intelligence⟦/Q⟧” and sought to gather all government into the system capital (53:4.2). He contended that “majorities rule,” that “⟦Q 53:4.4⟧mind is infallible⟦/Q⟧” (53:4.4).
53.b20.p: His superiors seemed to take no notice, and Lucifer pointed to the merciful delays of justice as proof that the Paradise government was powerless (53:4.4-4.5). Gabriel announced only that he would speak for Michael in due time and that all beings would be left free in their choice (53:4.6). The Constellation Fathers confined the rebellion to Satania, but the period of delay was a time of great trial for the loyal (53:4.7).
53.b21.q: ⟦Q 53:4.6⟧The “government of the Sons for the Father desired only that loyalty and devotion which was voluntary, wholehearted, and sophistry-proof.”⟦/Q⟧
53.b23.p: After conferring with his Paradise brother Immanuel, Michael announced that he would follow the same policy he had used in past upheavals: noninterference (53:5.1). At that time Michael ruled as vicegerent of the Father; he had not finished his bestowal career and did not yet rule in his own personal right (53:5.2). So the rebels were allowed a free course for almost two hundred thousand years. Michael now has the power to act promptly, but it is doubted that he would act differently if another upheaval came (53:5.3).
53.b24.t: Three azure blue concentric circles on a white background
A white banner with one red circle and a black solid circle in its center
The Trinity government of all creation
53.b25.p: The “⟦Q 53:5.6|53:5.7|53:7.12⟧war in heaven⟦/Q⟧” was not a physical battle. Lucifer held forth in the amphitheater, Gabriel exposed the rebel sophistries from his nearby headquarters, and many personalities went back and forth between the two until they made their decision. Material war risks material life, but this war was far more deadly, for it was fought in terms of life eternal (53:5.6-5.7).
53.b27.p: The most thrilling act of devotion during the rebellion was that of Manotia, second in command of the seraphim at the Satania headquarters. When the head of the seraphic hosts, blinded by Lucifer’s dazzling personality, went over to his side, a great many of the fourth order, the system administrator seraphim, went astray (53:6.1-6.2). Manotia refused to join in the projected insult to Michael. The rebels sought to destroy him, but not a single loyal seraphim was harmed (53:6.3).
53.b28.p: Taking command, Manotia held on with the help of the Melchizedeks, the Material Sons, and the ascending mortals of Jerusem until the new System Sovereign arrived. He testifies that order, loyalty, and the spirit of truth are inherently triumphant over rebellion and self-assertion, and he still serves on Urantia as associate chief of seraphim (53:6.4-6.6).
53.b30.p: Thirty-seven seceding Planetary Princes swung their world administrations largely to the rebel side. Only on Panoptia did the Prince fail to carry his people with him. There a young woman, Ellanora, took the lead of the human races, and not a single soul enlisted under Lucifer’s banner; the Panoptians now serve as caretakers and builders on the Father’s sphere (53:7.1). When the rebellion broke out, all Satania was cut off from the constellation and universe circuits, and these circuits will not be restored so long as Lucifer lives within Satania (53:7.3).
53.b31.t: Beings of Paradise origin and Trinitized Sons
Slightly over a third fell — Manotia saved almost two thirds
Of 681,227 lost in Satania, 95% were casualties of the rebellion
Not a single one took part
53.b32.p: The ascending mortals withstood the sophistries of rebellion better than the lower spirits. When the new Sovereign, Lanaforge, arrived, his first message reported that not a single Jerusem citizen was lost; all 187,432,811 ascending mortals survived the fiery trial (53:7.10, 7.12). The assurance went on to Paradise that the survival experience of mortal ascension is the greatest security against rebellion. Since the fall of the thirty-seven, Satania has not lost another world (53:7.15).
53.b33.h: 8. The Son of Man on Urantia
53.b34.p: Lucifer and Satan were last on our world together during their combined assault on the Son of Man (53:8.1). After that attempt to corrupt Michael, all sympathy for them perished throughout Satania, except on the isolated worlds of sin (53:8.2). When the Master replied, “⟦Q 53:8.4⟧Get you behind me, Satan,⟦/Q⟧” there was survival for mortals and security for angels; that was, in principle, the real end of the Lucifer rebellion (53:8.4).
53.b35.p: Before leaving Urantia, Michael offered mercy one last time to Caligastia and Daligastia, but they spurned it. Caligastia is still free on Urantia, but he has absolutely no power to enter the minds of men or draw near to their souls unless they really desire his presence (53:8.6). Since Pentecost these rebels are servile before the Thought Adjusters and the Spirit of Truth (53:8.7).
53.b36.q: “⟦Q 53:8.8⟧He who is born of God keeps himself, and the wicked one touches him not.⟦/Q⟧”
53.b37.p: Weak mortals who are thought to be under the influence of devils are usually just being led by their own natural tendencies. The devil has been given a great deal of credit for evil which does not belong to him (53:8.9).
53.b39.p: From the early days of the rebellion Michael offered forgiveness and restoration to every rebel who sincerely repented. None of the leaders accepted, but thousands of angels and lower beings, including hundreds of Material Sons and Daughters, accepted mercy and were rehabilitated at the time of Jesus’ resurrection (53:9.1). Once Michael became the settled ruler of Nebadon, Lucifer was taken into custody by agents of the Ancients of Days and is now a prisoner on satellite number one of the Father’s group of the Jerusem transition spheres (53:9.2). Satan too is now unqualifiedly detained on the prison worlds (53:9.4).
53.b40.p: All await the Uversa verdict in the case of Gabriel vs. Lucifer. When it comes, the interned rebels are expected to “⟦Q 53:9.7|47:2.7⟧become as though they had not been⟦/Q⟧” (53:9.7). For ages the seven prison worlds of Satania have proclaimed solemn truths to all Nebadon (53:9.8).
53.b41.t: Truth proclaimed by the prison worlds
“⟦Q 53:9.8|75:6.3⟧The way of the transgressor is hard⟦/Q⟧”
The road of rebellion torments those who walk it
“⟦Q 53:9.8⟧Within every sin is concealed the seed of its own destruction⟦/Q⟧”
Sin falls apart from within, not from without
Refusing mercy to the end leads to extinction
53.b43.p: Paper 53 makes plain that the rebellion began not in outward conditions but in the pride of one being’s heart. The brilliant Lucifer passed through self-contemplation and self-deception into a rebellion that claimed liberty, denying the reality of the Father, the rule of the Son, and the plan of ascension. Even so, Michael did not step in at once. He gave every being time to choose, and he held out the mercy of repentance to the end. Through that long testing Manotia, Ellanora, and the ascending mortals of Jerusem — not one of whom fell — stayed loyal. In principle the rebellion ended when the Son of Man turned Satan away, and what guards us today is not fear but the armor of faith.

53.b46.box: Rebellion begins in pride and ends in the refusal of mercy, but the wicked one cannot touch a son of faith.
54.title: Problems of the Lucifer Rebellion
54.b0.ask: “Why is a rebellion that cried out for liberty really a theft of liberty, and why did a God of love bear with that evil for so long?”
54.b2.p: In Paper 53 we followed how the Lucifer rebellion began and unfolded. Now Paper 54 takes up the hard questions that event has left us. Evolutionary man finds it difficult to grasp fully the meaning of evil, error, sin, and iniquity (54:0.1).
54.b3.p: First the paper states plainly: the Gods neither create evil nor permit sin and rebellion. Potential evil exists in a universe with differing levels of perfection, and sin is potential wherever imperfect beings are able to choose between good and evil (54:0.2).
54.b4.p: What, then, was wrong with the liberty Lucifer proclaimed? And why did God not destroy the rebels at once, but wait so long?
54.b5.q: ⟦Q 54:4.8⟧Justice in a mercy-dominated universe may be slow, but it is certain.⟦/Q⟧
54.b8.t: Exists in time, in a universe with differing levels of perfection
The persistent pursuit of sin and error
54.b9.p: Of all the problems left by the Lucifer rebellion, none has caused more difficulty than the failure of immature mortals to tell true liberty from false (54:1.1). True liberty is the reward of evolutionary progress over the ages, and it rests on justice — intelligence, maturity, fraternity, and equity. False liberty is the subtle deception of the error of time and the evil of space (54:1.2). Liberty becomes suicidal when it is cut off from justice, duty, and spiritual values (54:1.4).
54.b10.t: Tends toward exploiting others for selfish gain
In keeping with the reign of love and the ministry of mercy
License — the forerunner of abject bondage
54.b11.q: ⟦Q 54:1.5⟧License masquerading in the garments of liberty is the forerunner of abject bondage.⟦/Q⟧
54.b12.p: If even the Supreme Rulers of the universe stand back in respect for the creature’s will, how dare any creature trample on the rights of his fellows in the name of personal liberty (54:1.9)? There is no error greater than the self-deception that makes a being crave power over others in order to take away their liberty (54:1.8).
54.b14.p: Ever since God projected Havona with the Son and in the Spirit, there has been an eternal pattern of shared participation in creation. Every creature of an evolving universe who aspires to do the Father’s will is destined to become a partner of the Creators in this adventure of reaching experiential perfection. Were this not so, the Father would hardly have given such creatures free will, nor would he indwell them (54:2.1-2.2).
54.b15.p: Lucifer’s folly was the attempt to short-circuit time in an experiential universe, and his crime was the attempt to deprive creatures of their freewill share in the long evolutionary struggle toward light and life. Dressed in the garments of liberty, his manifesto stands out in the clear light of reason as a monumental threat to steal personal liberty (54:2.3). What God had given men and angels — the privilege of sharing in the creation of their own destinies and that of their world — Lucifer would have taken away (54:2.4).
54.b16.q: ⟦Q 54:2.5⟧No being in all the universe has the rightful liberty to deprive any other being of true liberty, the right to love and be loved, the privilege of worshiping God and of serving his fellows.⟦/Q⟧
54.b18.p: Moral creatures always ask why the all-wise Creators permit evil and sin. But both are inevitable if the creature is to be truly free. The ability to choose good or evil is not a philosophical notion but a universe reality, and the Supreme Rulers will never let any being take this liberty away from a single personality (54:3.1).
54.b19.p: Wholehearted identification with sin is the equivalent of nonexistence, yet there must be enough time between that point and the execution of the penalty for the judgment to be found fair by all concerned — and even to win the approval of the sinner himself (54:3.2). If the rebel refuses to accept the verdict, the sentence is delayed, and the Ancients of Days annihilate no one until all moral values and spiritual realities are extinct, both in the evildoer and in all who sympathize with him (54:3.3).
54.b21.p: Parents who have raised children can better understand why Michael, a Creator-father, was slow to condemn his own Sons. Jesus’ story of the prodigal son shows how long a loving father can wait for an erring child to repent (54:4.2). If extended mercy might lead to repentance and rehabilitation, any length of delay in justice is fully justified (54:4.3). Most of the liberties Lucifer sought he already had, and others he would have received in the future; he lost them all through impatience (54:4.4).
54.b22.p: Mercy always provides a saving interval between seedtime and harvest. If the sowing is good, the interval tests and builds character; if it is evil, it gives time for repentance and correction. This restraint of justice by mercy proves that God is love (54:4.6). But these delays are not endless. While this revelation was being given, the first hearing in the case of Gabriel vs. Lucifer was held, and Satan was confined to the prison world with Lucifer (54:4.8).
54.b23.t: What was sown during the interval
It gives time for repentance and rectification
54.b25.p: The author is permitted to name twelve of the reasons why the rebels were not interned sooner (54:5.1). On Uversa forty-eight reasons are taught for allowing evil to run the full course of its moral bankruptcy and spiritual extinction — and there may well be as many more that are not yet known (54:5.14).
54.b26.t: Every wrongdoer has time to form a fully chosen attitude
Justice will never destroy what mercy can save
No loving father is quick to punish
Upright children must bear with an erring brother
Not yet having finished his bestowals, he lacked summary jurisdiction
They seldom execute wrongdoers without a full hearing
Let rebellion run its natural course of self-obliteration
A free course would sooner uproot all sympathy for the rebels
Every creature must have the chance to mature its choice
Do not hide rebellion; disclose it fully
Summary suppression would lead three times as many astray
From Paradise, judgment is simultaneous with the act
54.b27.p: The ninth reason is especially important. If every creature of Norlatiadek were not given a full and free chance to choose, the Paradise quarantine against doubt-stricken beings might have been extended to the entire constellation. To keep the doors of ascension open, rebellion had to develop fully so that everyone could settle his attitude completely (54:5.10). From the viewpoint of Uversa, Lucifer’s crime is being brought to trial within two and a half seconds of its commission (54:5.13).
54.b29.p: The way the rebels were treated is a vindication of divine love. The Creator Son and the Paradise Father are love-dominated in all their dealings with intelligent beings, and God as a Father takes precedence over every other aspect of Deity (54:6.1-6.2). When the father of a large family shows mercy to one erring child, the other children may suffer temporary hardship. Families, nations, worlds, and universes are all fellowships whose members share in the results of one another’s right and wrong doing (54:6.3).
54.b30.q: ⟦Q 54:6.4⟧None of these fraternal consequences of misbehavior in the group can ever jeopardize your eternal prospects or in the least degree deprive you of your divine right of Paradise ascension and God attainment.⟦/Q⟧
54.b31.p: At first the Lucifer upheaval looked like an unmitigated calamity. But while the sum of evil became almost stationary, the good effects kept multiplying, reaching even to Havona, and the Melchizedeks now teach that the good resulting from the rebellion is more than a thousand times the sum of all the evil (54:6.6). This harvest was possible only because all of Lucifer’s superiors took a wise and merciful attitude (54:6.7).
54.b32.t: The balance of good and evil
It looked like an unmitigated calamity for the system and universe
The good produced equaled the evil incurred
The good is more than a thousand times the sum of all the evil
54.b33.p: It is also a mistake to think that every mortal would have chosen the Paradise career if sin had never come. The ability to decline survival did not begin with the rebellion; it has always belonged to man’s free will (54:6.9). Our time-bound minds should be slow to criticize the delays of farseeing universe administrators, and as we ascend we will better understand how ultimate good can come from time-limited evil (54:6.8, 6.10).
54.b35.p: Paper 54 answers two questions raised by the rebellion. First, the liberty Lucifer proclaimed was self-assertion without self-control — in the end, a theft of liberty that would have robbed others of their right to share in creating their own destiny. True liberty grows only within justice and brotherhood, and it bears fruit in unselfish service. Second, God’s long patience with evil was not weakness but love. Mercy gave every being time to choose, let the rebellion be fully exposed so that the doors of ascension stayed open, and in the end produced good more than a thousand times greater than the evil. Whatever we suffer through the wrongdoing of others is only temporary, and nothing can take away our right to reach God.
54.b36.t: True liberty is the fruit of self-control; false liberty is the assumption of self-assertion
Lucifer tried to take away the creature’s right to share in shaping destiny
Judgment must be fair enough to win even the sinner’s approval
Mercy sets a saving interval between seedtime and harvest
Rebellion was allowed to run its course so that all could finish choosing
The good born of the rebellion is over a thousand times the evil
54.b38.box: Liberty is true only within love and justice, and God’s merciful delay reaps a greater good even out of evil.
55.title: The Spheres of Light and Life
55.b0.ask: “On a world that has reached light and life after the long struggle of evolution, how do death, government, and man himself change — and how far does the journey go?”
55.b2.p: In Paper 52 we saw a world pass through the visits of the Sons to the threshold of light and life, and in Papers 53 and 54 we looked at the tragedy of Urantia’s departure from that procession. Now Paper 55 shows the destination toward which the whole journey leads. The age of light and life is the final evolutionary attainment of a world of time and space; it begins when the Trinity Teacher Sons finish their last mission and continues indefinitely (55:0.1-0.2).
55.b3.p: Worlds settled in light and life are destined to go on throughout all the eternal ages to come (55:0.3). The era unfolds in seven stages — planetary, system, constellation, local universe, minor sector, major sector, and superuniverse — yet any world can reach the planetary values of any stage quite independently of other worlds or of higher administration (55:0.4-0.12).
55.b4.p: How, then, do people live and depart on a world settled in light and life? And what happens when such worlds gather, one by one, until the whole universe is settled?
55.b5.q: ⟦Q 55:2.5⟧On worlds settled in light and life, “funerals” are occasions of supreme joy, profound satisfaction, and inexpressible hope.⟦/Q⟧
55.b8.p: A morontia temple at the planetary capital is the certificate that the world has entered light and life. The Teacher Sons preside on the day when the “⟦Q 55:1.1⟧holy temple comes down upon earth,⟦/Q⟧” and the Paradise bestowal Son of that planet comes in person to proclaim the Planetary Prince as Planetary Sovereign (55:1.1). The temple is said to come “⟦Q 55:1.3|139:3.5|153:2.10⟧down from heaven,⟦/Q⟧” but in fact its plans are drawn on the system capital and carried to the planet by the Morontia Power Supervisors, who build it there (55:1.3).
55.b9.t: The sanctuary of the Paradise bestowal Son
The Planetary Sovereign (formerly the Planetary Prince)
The acting chief of the planet’s finaliters
55.b10.p: Seating about three hundred thousand, the temple is not used for worship or play. It is reserved for special ceremonies: communication with higher authorities, ceremonies that make spirit beings visible, silent cosmic contemplation, graduations, and the recognition of outstanding service (55:1.4). Above all, it is where people gather to witness the translation of living mortals to morontia existence; being made of morontia material, it is not consumed by the blazing fire of fusion (55:1.5).
55.b12.p: Natural death is not a mortal inevitability. Most of the advanced beings on worlds in the final era of light and life do not die; they are translated directly from life in the flesh to morontia existence (55:2.1). By the end of the Teacher Sons’ terminal mission about a quarter are spared natural death, and by the fourth stage more than half leave the planet by translation (55:2.2, 2.8).
55.b13.t: The midway creatures sense that soul-Adjuster union is near
Word passes through the destiny guardians to the finaliter group
The Planetary Sovereign calls the mortal to resign his duties and bid farewell
Family and friends assemble around the central stage of the temple
The mortal departs in spiritual flames, straight to the resurrection hall
55.b14.p: The weeping and wailing of earlier ages, when the dead were committed to the earth, give way to ecstatic joy as loved ones bid a passing farewell. The mood is like that of friends gathered for a graduation (55:2.5-2.6). Souls translated in this way do not pass through the mansion worlds; their first service is on the worlds of the universe headquarters (55:2.9). Still, so that no ascender misses anything essential, the seven mansion spheres give them the chance to master the skipped stages as teacher-students (55:2.11-2.12).
55.b16.p: In this age the world prospers with one language, one religion, and, on normal worlds, one race. Yet it is not perfect: there are still hospitals, and accidents and the infirmities of old age still need care. Even so, if we were suddenly taken there, we would call it heaven on earth (55:3.1). One world in the first stage that the author visited financed its public activities by a tithe: every adult worker paid ten per cent of his income (55:3.2).
55.b17.t: Against accident, disease, old age, and disaster
55.b18.p: The highest honor is the order of “supreme service,” bestowed in the morontia temple, and most posts and judicial trusts are held jointly by men and women (55:3.8-3.9). Even such worlds still present plenty of evil, real and potential, to stimulate choice (55:3.10). Urantia’s great handicaps on the way to this destiny are disease, degeneracy, war, multicolored races, and multilingualism; no world can progress beyond the first stage until it has one language, one religion, and one philosophy (55:3.21-3.22).
55.b20.p: Settled worlds make marvelous progress under the volunteer Corps of the Finality — ascenders who reached Paradise and came back to serve their brethren in the flesh (55:4.1). The liberated midwayers become interpreters for the finaliters, and discoveries of physical science allow mortals to see these once-invisible cousins (55:4.8). With each new stage the government is readjusted (55:4.3).
55.b21.t: Three rulers: the Planetary Sovereign, the chief of finaliters, and Adam and Eve
A Life Carrier comes as volunteer adviser to purify the race further
A new appreciation of the Ancients of Days; an elective mortal chief executive appears
Teacher Sons and trinitized sons come in pairs as counselors
Readjustments mostly in the physical domains
Cosmic wisdom becomes part of the mind circuits
Superuniverse advisers join; Adam and Eve are always relieved of duty
55.b22.p: In the third stage the elective mortal chief executive serves alongside the Planetary Sovereign for twenty-five years of planetary time (55:4.15). Released from their long assignment, Adam and Eve may choose among several paths — starting the Paradise career at once, or first serving as teachers or on the supreme court before receiving Adjusters (55:4.24-4.29). On the evolutionary worlds a being must humanize to receive a Thought Adjuster (55:4.31).
55.b24.p: The advanced stages of light and life are the peak of evolutionary material development. Poverty and social inequality have all but vanished, and degeneracy and insanity are rare. Economic life has become ethical, and science, art, and industry serve higher aims (55:5.2-5.3). War is a matter of history; there are no armies or police forces, and self-control is slowly making human laws obsolete (55:5.4).
55.b25.q: ⟦Q 55:5.4⟧The extent of civil government and statutory regulation, in an intermediate state of advancing civilization, is in inverse proportion to the morality and spirituality of the citizenship.⟦/Q⟧
55.b26.p: Schools are devoted to the training of mind and the expansion of soul, and people compete to excel in the sciences and philosophies of cosmology. Life is refreshingly simple: mechanical progress and intellectual attainment are crowned by spiritual achievement, and the pursuit of happiness is an experience of joy and satisfaction (55:5.5-5.6).
55.b28.p: As society grows more peaceful, the individual becomes more altruistic and fraternal, without losing his independence or his devotion to his family (55:6.1). Yet these people are still mortal; they breathe, eat, and sleep. Such a world is not heaven, but a sublime foreshadowing of the divine worlds of the Paradise ascent (55:6.2). Communion with the Adjusters deepens, and in the fourth stage people seem to have considerable conscious contact with the presence of the Master Spirit (55:6.4).
55.b29.p: Physical evolution is thought to reach its full development by the end of the fifth stage, but there may never be a limit to the attainment of wisdom (55:6.5). And all this splendid development is achieved by material mortals before they even begin their morontia careers — it is only the very first stage of an endless ascent (55:6.7).
55.b30.q: ⟦Q 55:6.9⟧Were there no future of eternal creature progression, still the superb evolutionary attainments of the mortal races on such settled worlds of perfected achievement would amply justify man’s creation on the worlds of time and space.⟦/Q⟧
55.b32.p: This stage runs from the appearance of the morontia temple until the whole system is settled (55:7.1). Because the Planetary Sovereign and the finaliters are invisible outside the temple, the outward and visible rulers are Adam and Eve. It is this arrangement that has given prestige to the idea of kings and queens throughout the universe (55:7.2).
55.b33.p: When Urantia reaches this age, Machiventa Melchizedek, now the vicegerent Planetary Prince, will no doubt take the seat of Planetary Sovereign, and it has long been conjectured that a son and daughter of the Urantia Adam and Eve, now on Edentia, will join him (55:7.3). When the youngest world in a system has been settled for a millennium, the whole system enters the second stage (55:7.4).
55.b35.p: When a whole system is settled, the Planetary Sovereigns become members of the system conclave, and the system becomes virtually self-governing. Each planet sends ten representatives to the legislative assembly, courts sit on the system capital, and only appeals go to the universe headquarters (55:8.1). The System Sovereign no longer changes; he remains at the head of his system forever (55:8.3).
55.b36.p: In this stage midsoniters come for the first time as counselors. What the Material Sons did for the races biologically, the midsonite creatures now do in the realms of philosophy and spiritualized thinking (55:8.4). When the last system of a constellation is settled, the Most Highs are proclaimed unqualified rulers of its hundred systems (55:8.7).
55.b38.p: When a whole constellation is settled, executive authority is redistributed and many constellation and universe activities move to the system capitals. Some superuniverse administrators settle on the constellation capitals as volunteer advisers to the Most High Fathers (55:9.1). The legislative function ceases and the house of System Sovereigns, presided over by the Most Highs, takes its place; for the first time these bodies deal directly with the superuniverse government on matters of Havona and Paradise (55:9.2).
55.b39.p: The Constellation Fathers take on more and more functions, reaching near-complete autonomy in the sixth stage, and in the seventh they will be exalted to the true dignity signified by their names, the Most Highs (55:9.3).
55.b40.h: 10. The Fourth or Local Universe Stage
55.b41.p: When a local universe is settled, it swings into the superuniverse circuits, and the Ancients of Days establish a supreme council of unlimited authority. Made up of one hundred Faithfuls of Days under the Union of Days, its first act is to acknowledge the continued sovereignty of the Master Creator Son (55:10.1). For the first time the finaliter corps recognizes an authority outside Paradise — this supreme council (55:10.7).
55.b42.t: Change in the local universe stage
Freed from administration, he shares closer fellowship with the finaliters
Her ministry blends with that of the Master Spirit and the Infinite Spirit
One hundred form the high council of the Bright and Morning Star
Assigned to the service of the supreme council
Remain in their universe of origin with ever greater responsibilities
55.b43.p: The author believes that if Michael should ever leave Nebadon, Gabriel would become chief administrator with the Father Melchizedek as his associate, and that if the Creator Sons go to the outer universes, the Divine Ministers will surely go with them (55:10.10-10.11).
55.b44.h: 11. The Minor and Major Sector Stages
55.b45.p: Minor and major sectors play no direct part in the plan of settlement, and none of the seven superuniverses has yet come near this level (55:11.1). The fifth, minor sector stage seems to concern the physical equilibrium of a hundred local universes, while the sixth, major sector stage is thought to involve new intellectual attainments, perhaps the supreme realization of cosmic wisdom (55:11.2-11.4).
55.b46.p: Most clearly of all, no administration of a universe or superuniverse can limit or delay the progress of an individual planet or an individual mortal. Even on an isolated world, environmental limitations cannot thwart personal attainment (55:11.6-11.7).
55.b47.q: ⟦Q 55:11.7⟧Jesus of Nazareth, as a man among men, personally achieved the status of light and life over nineteen hundred years ago on Urantia.⟦/Q⟧
55.b49.p: What will happen when a superuniverse is settled cannot be forecast with certainty, since it has never yet occurred. But the Melchizedeks teach that sweeping changes will come to the whole organization, from the inhabited worlds to the superuniverse headquarters (55:12.1). It is believed that the Unqualified Supervisors of the Supreme, now only advisers, will become the high administrative body on the superuniverse headquarters; they represent God the Supreme alone (55:12.3-12.4).
55.b50.p: The settling of the whole grand universe in light and life will be the most profound event in the annals of eternity since the appearance of the central universe. Some hold that the Supreme Being will then emerge from the Havona mystery and dwell on the headquarters of the seventh superuniverse as the experiential sovereign of the perfected creation — but the author honestly adds, “⟦Q 55:12.2|55:12.5|19:5.8⟧we really do not know⟦/Q⟧” (55:12.5).
55.b52.p: Paper 55 is a paper of promise, showing that none of the struggles of evolution are in vain. On a world settled in light and life, death becomes a translation like a joyful graduation, war and poverty disappear, and self-control governs society in place of law. Such worlds gather until systems, constellations, and universes are settled in turn, moving toward the day when the whole grand universe is perfected under the experiential sovereignty of the Supreme Being. Yet the paper does not speak only of that vast vision. No administration can stop one person’s spiritual progress, and on isolated Urantia, Jesus of Nazareth, as one man among men, reached the status of light and life. The destination of the universe lies far in the future, but the way to it is already open today within a single person.

55.b55.box: Light and life is the far destination of the universe, yet that status can already be reached by a single person on an isolated world.
